fusions.name: Rockfall Seine
fusions.desc: Drops a mesh weighted with jagged stone on every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 damage and leaving each [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Slingstone
fusions.desc: Slings a jagged stone from a mesh pouch, dealing 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Gabion Wall
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of rubble packed in mesh, 5 tiles long, for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Heaped Cairn
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stone drops into the mesh around you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stone (28% at full). Unfed, a stone fades every 10 seconds. Your armour also rises by 5%.
